# Redundant copies and generated files

These files were relocated on 2026-11-17, not deleted. Original repository paths
are preserved beneath `waste/`.

- Source copies whose bytes exactly match a retained active source. The retained
  canonical path and SHA-256 are recorded in [manifest.csv](manifest.csv).
- Finder metadata, Python bytecode caches, and generated LaTeX intermediates.
- Finder/TeX artifacts previously isolated in `cand_del/`.

Final PDFs, bibliography source, and distinct historical source versions were
preserved in the active tree or [old/](../old/README.md). A repeated filename or
similar-looking output alone was not treated as evidence of redundancy.

To restore a file, move it to the original path in the manifest, checking that
doing so will not overwrite a newer file. Runtime caches and TeX intermediates
can be regenerated by their normal build tools.
